mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% triggers a loss of investor confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross 9.5% threshold within 3 months or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals contractionary policy, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS increase in the same month
failure_condition: GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS do not both increase in the same month or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals sustained growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not fall below 2% in late-cycle expansion or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO index (supply) reflects robust production, boosting demand and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show a sustained upward trend over 6 months or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST (demand) above 600 units signals strong consumer demand, prompting positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not exceed 600 units in 1 month or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: PAYEMS and UNRATE do not move in opposite directions in the same month or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a recession recovery regime, a decline in the INDPRO index below 90 signals weakening production, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not fall below 90 in recession recovery regime or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
